BMW Maps Gets 3D Navigation and Driver Assistance Integration via Mapbox

2026-09-16 Geekzilla.tech BMW Maps, Mapbox, 3D navigation, driver assistance, Highway Assistant, Operating System X, lane guidance, connected maps
Read the source article

Quick summary

BMW announced a major BMW Maps update arriving October 2026 with OS X, combining 3D navigation with driver assistance systems in a single screen view — developed with Mapbox to show real-time lane position, road level, and surrounding environment.

Key takeaways

  • BMW Maps update arriving October 2026 for vehicles equipped with BMW Operating System X
  • The update combines 3D navigation with driver assistance systems, showing route, environment, and exact vehicle position in a single view
  • Developed in collaboration with Mapbox for more precise environmental representation
  • Real-time display includes current lane, road level, and nearby environment through 3D graphics
  • Highway Assistant system can assist driving on compatible highways at up to 130 km/h with automatic lane changes
  • Semi-automated urban driving assistance planned for 2027 in select markets where regulation permits
  • Availability depends on vehicle equipment and local regulations; no timeline for Latin American markets yet
